evidence.observation: Title card is on screen; Enter is pressed at 1.77s and the session starts with SPROCKET at the spawn.
evidence.riff: The menu is one screen with one affordance. Nothing to configure before you can find out whether you like the jump.

evidence.observation: Holding move_right accelerates SPROCKET to the 160px/s cap; the winding key sits on the trailing side.
evidence.riff: Facing is encoded in the silhouette rather than in a colour, so you can read direction from the shape alone.

evidence.observation: Space at x=138 clears the starter's first gap; one jump only, no double jump available in the air.
evidence.riff: The jump is a fixed 56px rise measured in this engine, not the 53.3px the textbook formula predicts.

evidence.observation: The starter's own spike at x=320 and both original ledges are crossed unchanged.
evidence.riff: Every original solid, the original spike and the spawn keep their exact coordinates; only the finish moved.

evidence.observation: A 64px gap from the starter's last platform lands SPROCKET on The Junction at x=1024.
evidence.riff: The section opens on the same gap width as the starter's very first gap, so it asks for something already proved.

evidence.observation: Two 64px stones over open pits, landed at 7.87s and 8.70s, then the ground run at 9.50s.
evidence.riff: Landing windows reach 24px beyond the furthest a jump can carry, so committing always lands and only leaving early misses.

evidence.observation: The painted chevron band on the ground marks the take-off window; SPROCKET jumps from it at x=1600.
evidence.riff: The paint sits on the measured take-off window, so the marking and the physics describe the same span.

evidence.observation: A 48px climb puts SPROCKET on the terrace at y=265.5, above the ground he was on a moment earlier.
evidence.riff: Forty-eight pixels against a measured 56px apex: the hardest jump in the game, with 8px of margin.

evidence.observation: The raised spike bank at x=1760 is drawn on the terrace walkway exactly where its trigger is, and is hopped.
evidence.riff: Art and trigger now come from one function, so a raised hazard cannot be painted 64px away from the thing that kills you.

evidence.observation: On this road SPROCKET passes x=1760 at y=319.9 with on_floor true: on the ground, underneath the terrace.
evidence.riff: Eight pixels of headroom. It is walkable precisely because the low road never requires a jump.

evidence.observation: SPROCKET overshoots the flag to the buttress at x=1995, turns, jumps left onto the terrace and completes at x=1851.
evidence.riff: The safe road's cost is distance, not danger: the only way up is past the flag, so you pay 2.28 seconds to avoid the spikes.

evidence.observation: The goal Area2D at x=1824 fires on the terrace and the completion card appears.
evidence.riff: The flag moved from 916 to 1824, so the new section cannot be skipped by either road.

evidence.observation: Space pressed 70px early leaves The Junction short; SPROCKET is logged at y=435.9, below the 430 fall line, and dies.
evidence.riff: The only failure this geometry permits: you cannot overshoot a stone, so every miss is a jump taken too early.

evidence.observation: The retry card holds for about half a second and the attempt restarts at the spawn without any key press.
evidence.riff: No lives, no menu, no keystroke. The cost of dying is the half second it takes to get you back.

evidence.observation: The same run, played correctly after the death, reaches the flag with deaths=1.
evidence.riff: Failure and recovery in one unbroken take: the retry counter is the only thing that remembers.

evidence.observation: Escape mid-jump freezes SPROCKET at y=264.00 and he is still at exactly 264.00 forty-five frames later; Enter resumes.
evidence.riff: Pausing mid-air is the honest test: the jump has to survive being interrupted without handing back a free one.

evidence.observation: R restarts the attempt from x=278.2 back to x=64.0 with the retry counter unchanged at 0.
evidence.riff: A manual restart is not a death, which is why the counter does not move when you press R.

evidence.observation: Escape then M returns to the main menu state from a paused attempt.
evidence.riff: The pause card is the only place M appears, and it is the way back out of a run.

evidence.observation: Enter on the completion card starts a fresh attempt with deaths=0 and jumps=0.
evidence.riff: Replay resets the counters, so a second run is a clean measurement rather than a continuation.

evidence.observation: The progress bar advances across the new section and is not full until the relocated flag.
evidence.riff: The bar used to divide by a hard-coded 852 and read 100% at 48% of the course; it now scales to the real finish.

features.reason: The GDD proposes twenty optional cherries. Not built in the starter slice and not added here.
The GDD proposes a full three-zone course. This build is the starter's control/retry slice plus one added section, not the full course.
The GDD proposes a settings screen. Not built; there is nothing to configure in this build.
No sound is implemented in this build. The film adds no fabricated game audio and states the game is silent.
The GDD proposes a locally tested Web export. Not built; this is a source release run from the editor or the launcher.
